card.name: Route words like oral and IV
card.fires_on: Administration route words such as oral, IV, intravenous and ophthalmic solution, mostly in overdosage and dosing text. The route word sits right before a dose or LD50 figure.

modes.label: Oral in overdosage
modes.description: The word oral opening an overdosage statement about doses or LD50.
modes.example: OVERDOSAGE The<< oral>> LD 50 of isotretin

modes.label: IV route in dosing
modes.description: IV or intravenous written after a dose in an antibiotic dosing list.
modes.example: 100 mg/kg/day<< IV>> in equally divided doses every 4 to

modes.label: Dosage form after drug name
modes.description: The word solution after an ophthalmic drug name.
modes.example: timolol maleate ophthalmic<< solution>> (preservative free) should be observed

card.writes: It suppresses words like outside, inside and external, so it steers away from location words after a route term.
card.plain: It lights up on the word saying how a drug is given, like oral or IV, in dosing and overdose text.
